Reading pp. 94, 97-99 against the Lean sources, every clause of Lemma 8.8 is stated: (8.26) as actualRadialError_eq_formula (equivalently gr_change), (8.27) as RankGeometry.debt_eq_remainders, and both gains as rankStage_gain_of_targets, with gr, radialRemainder, remainders and defects matching the paper term for term, including the 2b Dbeta + 2beta Dbeta, the -1/2 axial pressure moment and the exponent alpha + 0.9 - 2 kappa_s. No single declaration conjoins the three, which conjoin by unfolding alone, so the verdict is OK with relation different_formulation: A's lean_stronger overstates, since Lean also carries hypotheses the paper's lemma does not display, all of them part of the manuscript's standing setting.

findings.summary: No declaration states Lemma 8.8. Clause (i) is actualRadialError_eq_formula, clause (ii) is RankGeometry.debt_eq_remainders, clause (iii) is rankStage_gain_of_targets. All three speak of the same objects and conjoin by logic alone.

Hypotheses are reorganized: Lean never assumes divergence-freeness of (beta,v,gamma) nor any growth bound on V, and instead makes the construction's standing setting explicit (LocalOperators, IsSlowOn V and G, shell-supported covariance, patch strictly inside the gauge shell, NormalizedParameters).

The support-local form the paper emphasizes is proved but never consumed: rankStage_gain_of_targets has no call sites and its file is imported only by the paper-results aggregator; the main chain uses a variant with base bounds on the whole moving strip.
